require "bigdecimal"

class Money
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :amount, :currency

  def initialize(amount, currency = "USD")
    @amount = BigDecimal(amount.to_s)
    @currency = currency
  end

  def <=>(other)
    return unless other.is_a?(Money) && currency == other.currency

    amount <=> other.amount
  end

  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Money) && amount == other.amount && currency == other.currency
  end
  alias eql? ==

  def hash
    [amount, currency].hash
  end

  def format
    "#{currency} #{Kernel.format('%.2f', amount)}"
  end
  alias to_s format
end
